name: Rami Levy Shekma Real Estate Ltd.
summary: Rami Levy Shekma Real Estate Ltd. engages in the investment, management, and development of real estate properties. Its portfolio includes shopping centers, shopping malls, centers leased to food and bookstore retail chains, logistics centers, warehouses, industrial areas, plots of land, and other areas such as housing units, offices, hotels, and other assets. The company was founded on October 14, 1985 and is headquartered in Jerusalem, Israel.
